title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Build 284 (Android Biometric & PIN Fix, Smooth Navigation, Mobile Delete)
highlights: Android Biometric & PIN Security: Resolved fingerprint scanner session and OEM compatibility on Android, ensuring instant biometric unlock without requiring PIN reactivation.

Seamless Mobile Navigation: Fixed return animation from Invoice Settings to eliminate background flicker and tab desynchronization; restored smooth direct tapping between Home, Products, and other bottom tabs.
Direct 1-Tap Delete in Mobile Saved Bills: Added an instant Delete button right beside Payments on each saved bill card with stock restoration confirmation.
fixes: Updated BiometricService availability and authentication options to support all Android fingerprint sensors.
Synchronized app lock session tokens on PIN unlock to preserve biometric authentication across app launches.
Eliminated transition flash and PageController offset mismatch when navigating back from Invoice Settings.
Added direct Delete button and 3-dots popup option in MobileSavedSalesPicker.
Removed Tamil text references from Invoice Settings.
Updated Build 284 Windows installer and Android release packages.
